known_resolution: Assigning to attribute flask.g.[...] not defined in class slots (assigning-non-slot).
issue_title: Assigning to attribute flask.g.[...] not defined in class slots (assigning-non-slot)
issue_body: Following the flask documentation, it appears the recommended way of setting new attributes to flask.g is simply doing flask.g.some_attribute = some_value. Gives pylint warning: E0237: Assigning to attribute 'some_attribute' not defined in class slots.

known_resolution: Support callable SECRET_KEY configuration value for secret rotation.
issue_title: feature request: secret key has a callable
issue_body: A request to support secret key has a callable. Having the possibility to dynamically change configuration values serves easier secret rotation.

known_resolution: Strip Authorization header on redirect whenever root URL or scheme changes.
issue_title: Should Authorization header be cleared in https -> http redirect?
issue_body: When requests followed an HTTP redirect from HTTPS to HTTP, or across different ports on the same hostname, it kept the Authorization header because rebuild_auth only checked hostname changes, leaking credentials over plain HTTP.

known_resolution: Preserve proxy authentication credentials when prepend_scheme_if_needed formats URL.
notes: Proxy auth URL parsing credentials preservation.
issue_title: Proxy authentication bug
issue_body: In requests v2.27.0, when proxy URLs contained authentication credentials (e.g. http://user:password@proxy:8080), prepend_scheme_if_needed stripped the authentication portion.

known_resolution: Handle colons in relative URL paths properly when merging with client base_url.
notes: Relative URL path merging with colons.
issue_title: Bug with merging base_url with relative path if colon present in path
issue_body: When requesting relative URLs containing colons in path components (e.g., client.get('foo:bar')), URL.is_relative_url returned False because the portion before colon was treated as a scheme.

known_resolution: Preserve percent-encoded slashes in URL paths.
notes: URL path encoded slash normalization bug.
issue_title: Cannot request resources with paths that include a mix of path separator slashes and URL-encoded slashes
issue_body: A call to the URL 'http://a.b/c/a%2Fb' ends up requesting the path '/c/a/b' from the server, instead of '/c/a%2Fb'.

known_resolution: Configurability of temp directory cleanup in tmpdir/tmp_path fixtures.
issue_title: Configurability of temp directory cleanup
issue_body: Currently, pytest always deletes temp directories made with the tmpdir or tmp_path fixture, and always keeps the latest three. The parameters of temp cleanup should be configurable.

known_resolution: Maintain pytest.mark.skip location reporting when using --runxfail.
issue_title: skipping: --runxfail breaks pytest.mark.skip location reporting
issue_body: When running pytest with --runxfail, tests marked with pytest.mark.skip have their reported source location displaced.

known_resolution: Document recursive model copy behavior and copy_on_model_validation flag.
notes: Recursive model validation copying instance by reference vs value.
issue_title: Document that recursive models will make a copy of instances passed into a constructor by default?
issue_body: If you pass a model instance to a recursive model the parent makes a copy/new instance of the passed in child model instance instead of preserving the reference.

known_resolution: Resolve forward references in Config.json_encoders to avoid model_as_dict collisions.
notes: V1.9 JSON encoder forward reference resolution.
issue_title: V1.9 Name Collisions JSON model_as_dict
issue_body: When models use custom json_encoders specified with string type annotations or forward references, model_as_dict evaluates encoder keys by raw class name without resolving forward references.

known_resolution: Fix middleware AssertionError with test client when rendering templates.
issue_title: middleware: assert message['type'] == 'http.response.start'
issue_body: Adding a middleware to an app causes an assertion error with the test client when using Jinja2Templates: assert message['type'] == 'http.response.start'.

known_resolution: Fix JSON Schema for ValidationError at field loc when detecting error in array.
issue_title: validation_error_definition schema is incorrect when detecting an error in an array
issue_body: Pydantic's schema for the loc field of the error detail is Union[str, int] not str for cases when invalid data is at a particular index of an array.

known_resolution: Handle non-ASCII characters in request syntax during serving without UnicodeEncodeError.
notes: Serving request line non-ASCII parsing error.
issue_title: UnicodeEncodeError
issue_body: Exception happened during processing of request with bad request syntax containing non-ASCII characters: UnicodeEncodeError.

known_resolution: Macros always generate strings even in native environment.
issue_title: Native types for macros
issue_body: With native types we can template out native Python types. It seems that macros always generate strings though, even in a native environment.

known_resolution: Clarify allow_dash behavior on click.Path type vs File type.
issue_title: Usage of allow_dash flag for path parameters is not clear
issue_body: The allow_dash parameter to the click.Path type can be misleading because it writes to a file called '-' rather than interpreting as stdout.

known_resolution: Provide server_hostname for check_hostname when connecting to IP proxies with TLS.
issue_title: TLS-in-TLS not working with IP proxies
issue_body: Sending a GET request to HTTPS website through secure proxy triggers ValueError: check_hostname requires server_hostname.

known_resolution: Add US spelling 'gray' alongside UK spelling 'grey' in ANSI color names.
issue_title: Add US spellings to ansi color names
issue_body: We have some UK spellings of 'grey', we should add the US spelling as well ('gray').

known_resolution: Require Sequence in Schema.load and raise ValidationError for generators instead of skipping validates_schema.
issue_title: Wrapped validates_schema method is not called when .load is provided with a generator.
issue_body: When passing a generator into Schema.load(..., many=True), the per-item deserialization consumed the generator, causing @validates_schema methods to receive an empty generator.

known_resolution: Black --exclude pattern ignored when combined with shell wildcard paths.
notes: Exclude regex pattern matching with explicit file list.
issue_title: Black --exclude option does not work together with wildcard path
issue_body: When running black with --exclude and wildcard paths like black **/*.py --check --exclude 'build', the exclude pattern is ignored.

known_resolution: Add token validation error check in validate_token to reject empty tokens.
notes: Local hermetic fixture case. Pinned to test fixture snapshot.
issue_title: Empty token accepted in TokenAuthenticator
issue_body: TokenAuthenticator does not raise an error when an empty string token is passed to validate_token.
